summary:
Architectural implementation plan based on research:
1. Zero-permission remote touch and keyboard input via macOS Bluetooth HID peripheral emulation (0% Accessibility, 0% ADB, 100% store compliant).
2. Screen mirroring via standard Android MediaProjection and hardware-accelerated H.264/HEVC streaming.
3. App Play windowing via native intent launch and adaptive aspect-ratio framing.
4. UI De-hiving: replacing legacy honeycomb/bee elements in Setup and Walkthrough with modern Task Manager/System Monitor dashboard telemetry.
5. Help Center Rebrand: renaming Guide to Help Center with rich visual representations and interactive feature cards.
6. Unlocking Screen Mirror: removing artificial debugging lock gates for instant 1-click mirroring.
